capabilities: Add a "+" button to folder titles in the Files view on hover or keyboard focus
Create a new Markdown note directly inside the hovered folder
Select the new note's title for immediate renaming, matching native behavior
Keep the button always visible on mobile without overlapping the drag handle
Work across multiple File Explorer panes and clean up when disabled
extras: Installation is manual (copying plugin files into .obsidian/plugins); the README notes it avoids the global app instance and uses only Obsidian-provided APIs for mobile compatibility.
intentEvidence: Adds a subtle "+" button to every folder in Obsidian's Files view.
problem: Obsidian's Files view has no per-folder control for creating a note in a specific folder, so users must create notes elsewhere and move them or navigate through context menus.
summary: Files view add-on that puts a hoverable "+" button on each folder title to create a new note directly inside that folder.
